address: Avenida de la Constitución 98, Valverde del Camino, 21600, Spain
bio: Very easy to find, thanks to its location next to the beautiful English-style mansion which now houses the ethnographic museum (also known as the Casa Dirección). The restaurant is home to a tapas bar where you can enjoy mini versions of à la carte dishes, a dining room that looks onto a delightful terrace, a landscaped area for private events, and even an amphitheatre! In the bright dining room, the walls of which are somewhat unusually adorned with an array of shoe moulds, choose from an à la carte of updated traditional dishes and several menus, all of which include a wine pairing....
